ruleDefinitions.name: MSSQL Disable Audit Settings
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects when an attacker calls the "ALTER SERVER AUDIT" or "DROP SERVER AUDIT" transaction in order to delete or disable audit logs on the server Note: Unmapped fields: Provider_Name, Data

sequences.query: (Provider_Name = RGX(".*MSSQL.*") AND event_id = 33205 AND (Data = RGX(".*statement\\:ALTER\\ SERVER\\ AUDIT.*") OR Data = RGX(".*statement\\:DROP\\ SERVER\\ AUDIT.*")))
